resources.string: Twaronse ubutumwa bwo gusubiriza akajambobanga ka konte yawe.
Nimba ariwe warungitse ubwo butumwa, fyonda aho musi. Atar\'uko, ubu butumwa bwihoze.
Kugira mwemeze kwi\'yi email ari gwanyu, fyonda aho musi:
Ubu ni service email ijanye na konte yanyu %s.
%s ni link ya page yogufashwa: https://lichess.org/contact Iyo page ijanye n\'ukumenyesha ingorane mwagize, nkakarorero nkogu publia kuri forum canke kurungikira ubutumwa abakozi ba lichess.
